svg.title: Expected risk and empirical optimization excess
svg.desc: Exact expectations over all 16-sign training datasets. Upper plot is zoomed to iterations 3 through 16; initial risk 2 and iterations 1 and 2 are omitted; lower plot has logarithmic scale and remains strictly positive.
